'''September 2004 Franklin tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 18 September 2004 at Outer Limits in Franklin, Tennessee, announced by [[Micah Wooten]].<ref name="pcf-3961-54071">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54071#54071 Tourney In TN on Sept 18th...All Welcome], Micah Wooten (KeonUlic), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102220746/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54092%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> An uncut sheet was among the prizes, and Wooten also demonstrated [[WARS TCG]] at the event. The Franklin organizers had taken a month off because both Wooten and [[Royce Russell]] were at Gen Con for the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-3961-54071" />

Russell later wrote that he had heard from Wooten that the tournament was a success.<ref name="pcf-3961-54716">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54716#54716 Tourney In TN on Sept 18th...All Welcome], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102220746/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54092%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
